text: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャの　こわさを　みたな！

structure.jp: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャの
structure.en: of the ninja who still survive in modern times
you've seen the fearsomeness, haven't you!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: げんだいに　なお　いき　のこる　ニンジャ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before ニンジャ and tells you which ninja. げんだいに なお いき のこる ニンジャ = 'the ninja who still survive in modern times'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the final い of a describing word for さ turns it into a thing: how much of that quality there is. こわさ = 'fearsomeness'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a statement is a rough, male way of saying 'right?' or 'so you did'. みたな = 'so you've seen it!'.
